description: This file defines a React component named ProgressCharts that visualizes user workout progress using Chart.js. It fetches progress data from an API, manages chart rendering in useEffect hooks, and displays two types of charts: a line chart for body weight over time and a bar chart for best lifts.

methods.name: ProgressCharts()
methods.description: React functional component that fetches workout progress data and renders two charts: a weight line chart and a lifts bar chart.
